items.summary: I am very dissapointed with the new changes. I joined before Saya released and have been playing religiously only to see everything from the most offensive like the affinity changes making it much harder to increase affinity levels and the new difficulty update making all endgame modes p2w checks, and now there's minor adjustments that dont mean anything either. I will not be changing my rating untill it's fixed, and i really hope it does get fixed

items.summary: Update of an old review: the game is changing, and not in a good way. I am here on behalf of a lot of people to say that unless the game changes before the anniversary, I fear many people may quit (some already started to do so) It is not too late to turn the changes around instead of giving us 100 pulls and an apology as damage control.. That simply doesn't address the bigger issue and promises that were broken about HP inflation and meta characters.... Please address the issue when possible!

items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★2 Add 1 stage between normal - hard and 1
items.summary: Add 1 stage between normal - hard and 1 more stage between hard - nightmare in d-tide or change it back to the old system, a boss having 45k hp on normal is fine but, the boss has 545k hp the next difficulty, a 12x stat increase. Resources that u need to get stronger are locked behind those stages which just forces u to whale. Address the affinity issues, rerunning a wod banner and corpo banner only for u to nerf them after people pulled, adress the main story difficulty as well Thank you.
